description: Use this to start a new group. List the other members by name: the user is added as a member under their account name, or linked to the member already named like it. Pick an emoji icon that fits the group, and ask which currency it settles in when the user hasn't said. Read the new group with get_group for its members' tokens.

Color.description:
An avatar colour as an uppercase hex string. The server accepts only the
colours of its palette and answers 400 for any other; the palette can grow.

position.description: Its place in the category list, 1 first.

token.description: The category's token, chosen by the client.

color.description: Avatar colour, or `null` for the default.

name.description: The member's name, as the group sees it.

token.description:
Optional client-generated token. When absent the server
generates one (`SecureRandom.base58(24)`).

Token.description:
Resource token: 24 base58 characters (the alphabet leaves out the
look-alikes `0`, `O`, `I` and `l`). A token never changes. The server
generates one when a create sends none; a client may choose its own for a
transaction, participant, category or recurring expense, so a write queued
offline already knows the token it will have.

categories.description:
Optional complete initial category set for an offline-created duplicate.
When supplied, the server preserves these client tokens and does not add
its default categories. When omitted, the regular defaults are created.

creatorParticipantToken.description:
Token of the participant in `participants` who is creating the group.
With an account credential that participant is linked to the account as
admin and moved first. When omitted, the participant named like the
account is, or else a new one is added. Must match one of the supplied
participant tokens.

currency.description: Base currency. When omitted, the account's preferred currency, else the request country's, else USD for English and JPY otherwise.

icon.description: An emoji shown as the group's icon.

idempotencyKey.description: A UUID you make up for this call. If the call fails or gets no answer and you try again, send the same UUID so nothing is added twice. Use a new one for each new thing you add.

name.description: The group's name, such as a trip or a household.

previousGroupCount.description:
How many groups the client already had when it made this one, so a
device without an account can say whether this is its first group.
Analytics only; ignored with an account, whose own groups are counted.

name: create_group
title: Create a group
